title: Fewest Coins
statement: A ticket machine gives change with coins of the given values, each value available any number of times. Return the fewest coins that add up to exactly amount, or −1 if it cannot be done.

answerKey.pattern: 1-D DP over amounts: best(a) = 1 + min over coins c of best(a − c)
keyPoints: For every amount from 1 up, try each coin as the last coin
Unreachable amounts stay infinite; answer −1 if best(amount) is infinite
edgeCases: Greedy (largest coin first) fails, e.g. [1, 3, 4] for 6
acceptableSlowerApproaches: BFS over amounts: same bound, more code

hints: Why does taking the largest coin first fail for coins [1, 3, 4] and amount 6?
Think about the last coin used: best(a) = 1 + best(a − c) for the best c.
Fill best[0..amount] from small to large; initialize with Infinity.
